name: The Hero's Journey
description: Joseph Campbell's monomyth structure as adapted by Christopher Vogler for screenwriting — 12 stages of transformation.

beats.title: Ordinary World
beats.description: The hero's normal life before the adventure begins. Establish their routine, relationships, flaws, and the things they take for granted.

beats.title: Call to Adventure
beats.description: The hero is presented with a challenge, quest, or problem that disrupts their ordinary world. A herald delivers the call.

beats.title: Refusal of the Call
beats.description: The hero hesitates or refuses the call out of fear, obligation, or self-doubt. This shows the stakes and makes their eventual acceptance meaningful.

beats.title: Meeting the Mentor
beats.description: The hero encounters a wise figure who provides guidance, training, equipment, or self-confidence. The mentor helps the hero overcome their fear of the unknown.

beats.title: Crossing the Threshold
beats.description: The hero commits to the adventure and enters the Special World — a new, unfamiliar territory with different rules. There's no going back.

beats.title: Tests, Allies, and Enemies
beats.description: The hero explores the Special World, makes allies, faces enemies, and learns its rules. Each test prepares them for greater ordeals ahead.

beats.title: Approach to the Inmost Cave
beats.description: The hero nears the central ordeal. They prepare for the major challenge, cross a second threshold, and face their deepest fears.

beats.title: The Ordeal
beats.description: The hero faces their greatest challenge yet — a life-or-death crisis. They must 'die' (literally or metaphorically) to be reborn. This is the story's emotional center.

beats.title: Reward (Seizing the Sword)
beats.description: Having survived the ordeal, the hero takes possession of the treasure they sought: an object, knowledge, reconciliation, or greater self-understanding.

beats.title: The Road Back
beats.description: The hero begins their return to the Ordinary World. But the journey isn't over — they face pursuit, new dangers, and consequences of seizing the reward.

beats.title: Resurrection
beats.description: The final and most dangerous encounter. The hero is severely tested once more — a climactic battle where everything is at stake. They emerge transformed.

beats.title: Return with the Elixir
beats.description: The hero returns to the Ordinary World, but they are changed. They bring back the 'elixir' — a lesson, treasure, or gift that benefits their community.
